title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗~Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing
focus: 以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土~Verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction
summary: 本課以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為主線，從裂後承載與纖維橋接與力位移曲線的能量積分建立系統邊界，再把拔出功與界面滑移、荷重位移同步與零點連到性能規格與試法交接。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. It begins with Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging and Energy integration of force-displacement curves, links Pullout work and interface slip and Force-displacement synchronization and zero, and ends with Performance specifications and method handover. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 裂後承載與纖維橋接~Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging
units.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接~Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging
units.mechanism: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance. Inspect the complete postpeak curve rather than comparing maximum loads alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高~High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
units.practice: 將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 力位移曲線的能量積分~Energy integration of force-displacement curves
units.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分~Energy integration of force-displacement curves
units.mechanism: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積；若出現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area. Define displacement at the panel centre or specified location, and preserve the integration interval and discretization method. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度~Panel thickness and bending scale
units.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度~Panel thickness and bending scale
units.mechanism: 相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action. Fix geometry before treating energy as a material comparison. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 纖維方向與法向力分量~Fibre orientation and normal force
units.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量~Fibre orientation and normal force
units.mechanism: 纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings. Counts also depend on position, length and three-dimensional orientation, requiring section or image sampling rather than a force-projection shortcut. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 拔出功與界面滑移~Pullout work and interface slip
units.title: 拔出功與界面滑移~Pullout work and interface slip
units.mechanism: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. Single-fibre work belongs to that specimen system and cannot be multiplied by every fibre without interaction assumptions. Report embedment length and end shape with the result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 取樣批次與纖維分散~Sampling batches and fibre dispersion
units.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散~Sampling batches and fibre dispersion
units.mechanism: 材料平均纖維質量相同，局部團聚仍會造成弱區。小試樣若只來自易取位置，容易漏掉噴射陰影或回彈較大的區段；抽樣應保留空間位置，將分散度和平均值分開呈現，才能辨識材料混合與施工方向的影響。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散；若出現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Equal mean fibre mass can coexist with local clusters and weak zones. Convenient small samples can miss spray shadows or high-rebound areas. Retain spatial locations and report dispersion separately from the mean to distinguish mixing effects from placement orientation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 環境老化與殘餘能力~Environmental ageing and residual resistance

units.anchor: 性能規格與試法交接~Performance specifications and method handover
units.title: 性能規格與試法交接~Performance specifications and method handover

Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查裂後承載與纖維橋接：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60；再獨立檢查力位移曲線的能量積分：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。平均力由 20 增為 22 kN、位移仍為 25 mm，能量由 500 增為 550 J；試板尺寸或支承變更時不能沿用這個比例。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 將比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. At a fixed 25 mm travel, mean force rising from 20 to 22 kN increases energy from 500 to 550 J; changed panel geometry or support prevents direct transfer. The two results are not a complete design because panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Use compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
